title: Elastic critical load of a column, pinned base, pinned top

source.work: derived here (no publication): benchfea.oracle direct integration of the member equations / numerically solved characteristic equation

analysis: Linear buckling of a prismatic column, no shear deformation. Length 4 m, EI = 40 000 kN m^2 in both planes, reference load 100 kN. Target = smallest root of the characteristic determinant of EI v'''' + P v'' = 0 with the four end conditions, solved numerically.

targets.note: kappa = L sqrt(Pcr / EI) = 3.141592653590; Pcr = 24674.011 kN; reference load 100 kN
